name: CitizenReviewStateCs
title: Citizen observation review state
description: Proposed workflow states for a citizen observation. These describe where the observation is in the review workflow. They are NOT validated confidence levels.

concept.definition: Submitted by the contributor; nobody has checked it yet.
Passed or failed automated plausibility checks; no human review yet.
A reviewer judged the observation usable for follow-up.
A reviewer judged the observation unusable. Kept for audit.
A reviewer requested a professional visit or sample.
